purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: Industrial Project Finance and Digital Rails
question: Can tokenized credit, collateral, deposit or settlement rails be demonstrated inside a named industrial project-finance stack, and which legal and cash documents would prove it?
bluf: The six audited project-finance stacks did not establish crypto, stablecoin, tokenized debt, tokenized collateral or a deposit-token rail as a funding mechanism. Wholesale tokenization may be an adjacent operating rail, but a named borrower, instrument, investor cash, draw, settlement and loss path are required to connect it to a project.
use_note: Bounded negative finding through July 31. It applies to the six audited public financing stacks and their stated source limits; it does not prove that every private side letter, participant back office or later transaction avoids digital-asset technology.

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a public reading, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and preserve its schema_version, data_as_of, scope_boundary and evidence vocabulary.
A failure to retrieve public_full_text is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
